maeve: quick ping  hitting fuzzy types in the edge sample app when consumers bundle with esbuild + isolatedModules. overloaded SDK API types collapse to `any` in their repo.

harrison: ugh, got an example? package.json + tsconfig?

maeve: package.json snippet from sdk:
```json
{
  "type": "module",
  "exports": {
    "./": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs"
    }
  },
  "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```
consumer tsconfig (monorepo root):
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "module": "esnext",
    "target": "es2020",
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "skipLibCheck": false
  }
}
```

zara: two common failure modes: (1) umbrella d.ts contains top-level `declare global` or lib augmentations that leak into consumer, (2) internal helpers compiled with `as any` collapse generics so overloads become `any`.

harrison: TS resolves `types` regardless of import/require branches so a single umbrella d.ts can be the culprit. we should emit per-entrypoint d.ts and use conditional types in package.json: 
```json
"types": { "import": "dist/esm/index.d.ts", "require": "dist/cjs/index.d.ts" }
```
This helps modern toolchains pick the right declaration.

maeve: agreed. immediate mitigation for affected customers is to set `skipLibCheck: true` in tsconfig, but that's a bandaid.

zara: actionable plan in the PR:
- remove bare `declare global` and move augmentations into `declare module '@redwood-inference/sdk' {}` files
- audit emitted d.ts for any `export {}` at top level (ensures module scope)
- replace `as any` in helpers with `unknown` + explicit overloads so d.ts preserves generics
- emit per-entrypoint d.ts and add conditional `types` in package.json
- add an esbuild+isolatedModules consumer test to devex CI to replicate the exact edge dev flow

harrison: also add a lint rule to flag top-level ambient declarations in src and fail CI if any get emitted.

dev-bot: types job report  branch fix/edge-dts-scope (job #307)  failed. trace: TS2300 Duplicate identifier 'Window' in dist/types/global-augment.d.ts

maeve: i'll open the PR with the d.ts split + helper fixes and include a minimal repro. will add a short migration note in SDK changelog so customers know about conditional types.

zara: nice. add a small README note in the edge sample recommending `skipLibCheck: true` for dev on edge until the fix is released.

harrison: happy to review the overload conversions  will watch for accidental loss of specificity when we replace `as any`.

maeve: thanks all, will ping when PR is up :raised_hands:
